content: Paulo na Andumila bhanakuhunda uhwangi
Ningapalite handa munganimbililite kya mandina, hata handa nungulongela megha mmughabhugha. Chonde, munimbilile nenga.
Nunguabhonela malili, malili ghanakuhuma kwa Chapanga, mana mwenga nikiatola handa kamwali linda ywa nyanyi, yununtolite kwa nnume yumu ghweka ywene ndo Kilisto.
Peni nunguyoghopa kukita, handa bhula Eva pakakuluhitwe kwa uchenjelo ghwa yula liyoka, mahwacho ghenu ghakotoke kupotohwa, munguuleka uhyubhalilo ghwenu ghwa hoto kwa Kilisto.

Mwenga munguyitikila kwa uyelole kyohele kinng'ombelwa na mundu ywohele, hata handa kungualandamiha Yesu yungi kafauti na yula yutunlandamihite kwa mwenga, ebu nhuki yungi kafauti na yula yumunkingamite, ebu nhalo ghungi ghwa maha kafauti na ghula ghumughuhyubhalilite kuhuma kwa twenga.
Peni, nunguhwacha ng'obhe kukita nenga mbelelwa kilibhi kupitingana muabheghite abho bhaalikema “Andumila akulu.”
Pangi nenga nungulongela ng'obhe maha handa pabhalongela bhombe, peni umanyi megha naghwo, nnando aghu tuubhoneha pekupeku kwa mwenga, kwa njila yoheli na nndaluko ghwoha.
Bhuli, nikitenda ng'obhe maha kulihuluha na kubhakweha mwenga kwa kubhalandamiha yaghi Nhalo ghwa Maha ghwa Kilisto?
Nikikungana utangwo kuhuma kwa mangwemuko ghangi gha bhandu bhaanyubhalila Kilisto na kuatumikila mwenga.

Hata pammeghite nungupala utangwo, nikiaghaha ng'obhe mwenga. Kya hoto amoo bha bhandu bhaanyubhalila Kilisto kuhuma ku Mekadonia bhaking'eghela ghala ghoha ghanughapalite, habhu nikilema kuapegha nhigho kwa mwenga hata kya mandinna na ndachweha kulikanikiha kubhegha nhigho.
Kulyaghila nungulongela hoto kwakya Kilisto, na kahone mundu ywohele ghwa ku Akaya ghwa kunganikiha kulidumbila nnando aghwo.
Bhuli, nungulongela habhu kiyaha nunguapala ng'obhe? Aka kaa! Chapanga kangumanya kukita nunguapala.
Nenga ndaghendelela kutenda kila kinukitenda hinu, ngati bhala bhaalikema andumila akulu alepelwe kuliloka kukita bhangutenda lihengo handa twenga.
Mana abho ndo andumila ahwangi, atendalihengo kwa ukubhuhi na bhangulitenda kubhegha ndo andumila bha Kilisto.
Akyo ndo kya kukangacha ng'obhe kiyaha hata Nchipila kangulighalambula kulitenda handa lihoka lya kung'anyima.
Kya habhu chepa nnando ghwa kukangacha handa na abho andumitumi bhake paalitenda handa andumitumi bha hoto. Muuhiko ghwabhe bhaamokola kila kiibhanogha kubhukana na mandendelo ghabhe.
Mapughwo gha Paulo handa Nndumila
Nungulongela kangi, mundu kakotoke kuhwachila ndo mmughabhugha. Peni handa munguhwacha habhu, nunguyupa munyihwe ngati na nenga nililoke nga kya mandina.
Aki kinukilongelite hinu kya kuliloka, chepa kila kyakanaghilite Bambo, habhu nungulongela handa mundu mmughabhugha.
Kiyaha bhandu atangalo bhangutumila milando ya munnima kuliloka, na nenga ndaliloka bhubho.
Mwenga mungulibhona mmegha na mahala, ndo mana mungualimbilila abhughabhugha kwa uyelelo!
Mungunnimbilila hata bhandu bhanakubhatenda mwenga abhandwa, bhandu bhaabhakuluha na kuhitola hilibhi hyenu kwa makakala, bhandu bhaalitika bhene, hata paabhabhakula muhibhungi hyenu.
Kwa honi nunguyitikila kukita twenga tukibhegha ayoyoho. Handa kabhegha mundu ywakanoghwa kulitika kwa kyohele, na nenga nungunoghwa kulitika, nungulongela habhu handa mmughabhugha.

Bhuli, bhombe ndo Akaaebulania? Na nenga bhubho Nuebulania. Bhuli bhombe ndo Akaaisilaeli? Na nenga bhubho Nunsilaeli. Handa bhombe ndo kibheleko kya Abulahamu? Na nenga bhubho nunbheleko ghwa Abulahamu.

Bhuli, bhombe ndo andumitumi ghwa Kilisto? Hinu nungulongela handa mughanikwa, peni na nenga ndo nndumitumi ywa Kilisto kyanalumu kupitingana bhombe! Nikikakalika muno kuntendela lihengo Kilisto, kubhikwa patangalo mu nyumba hya hibhopo kwakya Kilisto, ndutwa hinjupunjupu patangalo na nikibhegha ugheghela na kuhwegha patangalo.
Mala nhano hyoha hilongohi bha Akaayahudi bhakikwilikiha hyatwe hinjupunjupu mbinda mabhoko ndatu na tisa.
Nkihyatwa hinjupunjupu mala ndatu, nikighumwa malibho mala yimo, mala ndatu nikimetukilwa na meli mulihibha, na nikikilukiha kilukilu ndaa na legheleghe tipi.

Maghenda maghena pamegha mu mwanja nikibhegha munpingui ghwa machi ngumbwa ya mikemba, na npinguhi ghwa apoka, npinguhi kuhuma kwa akola nnima ayangu na kuhuma kwa bhandu bha milima yingi, npinguhi ghwa kumbwani, npinguhi ghwa kumanyahi, npinguhi ghwa kulihibha na npinguhi kuhuma kwa alongo ahwangi.
Ndenda lihengo na kupungwa, ngilukiha kyanaghonja patangalo, nikibhegha na njala na nyota ya machi, patangalo nikilikunga na kutama mumalili kyanga mapinda gha kulihwikila.
Kupitingana kwa ghangi matangalo, kila linjubha nungubhegha mu lihengo gha mangwemuko ghoha gha bhandu bhaanyubhalila Kilisto.
Handa bhandu bhangi ndo ayoyoho na nenga bhubho nu nnyoyoho, mundu ywohele pakannyambuha yungi katende ulemwa, na nenga bhubho nungukalala.
Payingwiliha kulitika, ndalitikila milando yila yiibhoneha uyoyoho ghwangu.
Chapanga na Tate ywa Bambo Yesu, lihina lyake likwihwe mu manjubha ghoha kya nga uhiko, ywombe kangumanya kukita nungulongela ng'obhe uhwangi.
Pameghite ku Damasikati nkulu ywa kitami, kiibheghite mu utabhala ghwa mutwa Aleta, kakibhegha kangukingikiha kitami ili kangamule.
Peni nikibhikwa mu kikapu kikulu, na nikihuluhwa panje kupitila lilanga lya kindupa, na nikinyelembuka mu makakala ghake.
